newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - First Virtual Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - First Virtual Q2 results.

text.p: Note a: Beginning in July 1996, the company instituted annual renewal fees and began to recognize revenues from consumer and merchant registration and renewal fees over a 12-month period. Prior to July 1996, revenues from registration fees were recognized in the month the registration fee was processed and the VirtualPIN was issued. As of June 30, 1997, deferred revenue was $579,544.

Note b: Shares used in computing net loss per share for the quarter ended June 30, 1997, excludes the warrants held by First USA Merchant Services to purchase 1,328,006 shares of common stock at an exercise price of 1 cent per share. Had the shares associated with these warrants been outstanding, the net loss per share for the quarter ended June 30, 1997, would have been 39 cents. These warrants were included in the pro forma net loss per share in 1996 pursuant to the requirements of the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Note c: Beginning in July 1996, the company instituted annual renewal fees and began to recognize revenues from consumer and merchant registration and renewal fees over a 12-month period. Prior to July 1996, revenues from registration fees were recognized in the month the registration fee was processed and the VirtualPIN was issued. As of June 30, 1997, deferred revenue was $579,544.

Note d: Shares used in computing net loss per share for the quarter ended June 30, 1997, excludes the warrants held by First USA Merchant Services to purchase 1,328,006 shares of common stock at an exercise price of 1 cent per share. Had the shares associated with these warrants been outstanding, the net loss per share for the quarter ended June 30, 1997, would have been 73 cents. These warrants were included in the pro forma net loss per share in 1996 pursuant to the requirements of the Securities and Exchange Commission.
